claims.title: Positive-real odd-frame rank-three crossing and integral dichotomy
claims.statement: The explicit positive-real ES family p(1,t/(4t-402),t/202,t/200), t>202, has one exactly isolated simple parameter at which the odd receiving matrix has rank three while the quartic remains squarefree. For distinct positive integral roots, N=S^6F is an integer; if N is nonzero, then |det O|>=4/S^3 and ||O^-1||_2<=41^3 S^12/4.
claims.scope: Interface theorem. The isolated crossing is not an integral witness, and arithmetic nonvanishing of N remains open.

claims.title: Perfect residue pairing and exact trace-degenerating multiplication
claims.statement: The rank-eight collision completion has perfect residue Gram determinant A^-8. Its trace pairing is the residue pairing composed with multiplication by 2 eta^3, with determinant 256 Disc(h)^3/A^14 and collision-local rank one. The local ES/RH algebra isomorphism requires the nonconstant residue unit c^3[1+(2/(3p)+s i/gamma) epsilon_E]. The metric pole has an unconditional positive lower bound after multiplication by |eta|.
claims.scope: Exact local boundary interface, not a global ES-zeta identification.

claims.title: Residue-to-native Gram multiplier with retained relation defect
claims.statement: For the native monic orthogonal polynomial, H=J_p q(C_p), with q retaining the original measure mass. For any monic root polynomial h, H_ij=[J_h k(C_h)]_ij+integral h(x) quo_h(x^(i+j)) d rho(x). The resolvent sign is stated under support in [0,infinity), or with the corresponding nonvanishing and denominator-sign hypotheses.
claims.scope: Cross-programme typed bridge. ES roots are not thereby native Gauss nodes.

claims.title: Inverse-trace native moment margin
claims.statement: The shifted-Legendre coefficient matrix gives the exact inverse of the interval monomial Gram. Its inverse trace tau_t yields J_t >= tau_t^-1 I, is within factor t+1 of the true minimum eigenvalue, dominates the earlier determinant-over-trace floor in every degree, and obeys tau_t <= (t+1)(2t+1)100^t. A degree-L weight needs moments through degree 2t+L.
claims.scope: RH-facing conditioning result outside the ES occupancy chain.

claims.title: Common-parameter quotient and Bernstein certification procedure
claims.statement: For one common diagonal uncertainty matrix, the attained quotient, determinant ratio and minimizing lift have the displayed exact ordered formulas. Fixed-column current numerators have bounded coordinatewise degrees, Bernstein subdivision gives a finite positivity procedure under a strict margin, and moving monic columns use the same parameters through an exact rational correction.
claims.scope: RH-facing propagation interface. The included diagnostics are synthetic and do not constitute an actual native-current sign certificate.

nonclaims: No universal Erdos-Straus occupancy theorem follows.
No integral nonvanishing theorem for the odd-frame integer N follows.
No Riemann-hypothesis theorem or counterexample follows.
No actual native-current sign certificate follows from the synthetic diagnostics.
The finite exact checks are not Lean verification or external peer review.
